extract: Valdrakken is the capital of the dragonflights located in Thaldraszus. It was founded in the ancient era of the Dragon Isles and has been the center of the ordered flights since its inception. The city is the culmination of all the dragons' efforts and provides several vignettes to enjoy, from the blue dragonflight's public library to the red and green dragonflights own separate gardens. This bejeweled city is a feast for the eyes and ears, with waterfalls cascading down the mountain surrounding the city and breathtaking views overlooking nearby Tyrhold, serving as a testament to the power of cooperation between the dragonflights and dragonkin. The city's guards are the Scalesworn led by Captain Drine. It served as the main hub for the adventurers during the events of World of Warcraft: Dragonflight.

It was founded in the ancient era of the [[Dragon Isles]] and has been the center of the ordered flights since its inception. The city is the culmination of all the [[dragon]]s' efforts and provides several vignettes to enjoy, from the [[blue dragonflight]]'s public library to the [[Red dragonflight|red]] and [[green dragonflight]]s own separate gardens.{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/23785116/world-of-warcraft-dragonflight-deep-dive|title=World of Warcraft®: Dragonflight Deep Dive|date=2022-04-19|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment}} This bejeweled city is a feast for the eyes and ears, with waterfalls cascading down the mountain surrounding the city and breathtaking views overlooking nearby [[Tyrhold]], serving as a testament to the power of cooperation between the dragonflights and [[dragonkin]].{{Ref web|url=https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23837375/dragonflight-city-preview-valdrakken|title=Dragonflight City Preview: Valdrakken|date=2022-08-04|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment}} The city's guards are the [[Scalesworn]] led by [[Captain Drine]].[[A Message Most Dire]] It served as the main hub for the [[adventurer]]s during the events of ''[[World of Warcraft: Dragonflight]]''.2022-11-24, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ySIpyIKR1hU Dragonflight Survival Guide | Live on November 28 | World of Warcraft]. ''YouTube'', retrieved on 2022-11-26 ==History== ===Ancient times=== Though much of the surrounding territory is shaped by [[titan-forged]] architecture, the [[Dragon|draconic]] culture left behind its own distinct mark, among the most splendid of their creations its the glorious city of Valdrakken. From the [[Seat of the Aspects]], the [[Dragon Aspects]] guided the vast lands of [[Azeroth]]{{Ref WoWCodex|67}} and ruled all of dragonkind with wisdom. Each flight is represented by an enclave within the city, including the [[Obsidian Enclave]], [[Sapphire Enclave]], [[Bronze Enclave]], [[Emerald Enclave]], and [[Ruby Enclave]]. Because of the [[Great Sundering]], much of the [[Dragon Isles]]' [[magic]] was drained away and the [[dragon]]s were forced to leave their homeland, including Valdrakken, in the care of the [[titanic watcher]]s, [[drakonid]], and [[dragonspawn]] that were left behind.{{Ref web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sIKV-FtuA2s|title=Dragonflight: Weaving a Story|author=World of Warcraft|publisher=YouTube|date=2022-04-19|accessdate=2022-04-19}} ===Dragonflight=== {{Df-section}} [[File:Valdrakken HS.jpg|thumb|Valdrakken in {{g|hs}}.]] Following the awakening of the [[Dragon Isles]], the [[dragonflight]]s returned to their most ancient city[[Valdrakken Accord]]'s in-game description along with their mortal allies of the [[Dragonscale Expedition]]. From their shining capital, the [[Valdrakken Accord]] was formed by the unified dragonflights to represent the might of all [[Dragon|dragonkind]], working harmoniously to carry out their orders.{{Ref web|url=https://news.blizzard.com/en-gb/article/23823105/dragonflight-major-factions-overview|title=Dragonflight: Major Factions Overview|date=2022-10-06|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment}} At the request of [[Alexstrasza|Queen Alexstrasza]], [[Captain Drine]] of the [[Scalesworn]] and the [[adventurer]]s hunted down the [[Primalists]] who infiltrated Valdrakken in an attempt to sway the citizens against the [[Dragon Aspects]] with their propaganda.[[Nowhere to Hide (Thaldraszus)]][[Eyes and Ears]] In the [[Artisan's Market]], the [[Artisan's Consortium - Dragon Isles Branch|Artisan's Consortium]] was eventually allowed to set up their camps to start trading. After the official reopening of the [[Algeth'ar Academy]], the staff made several orders to artisans in Valdrakken for supplies, including alchemic solutions for the future exams,[[Examination Week]] and enchanting rods for the enchantment formations.[[Spread the Enchantment]] Meanwhile, [[Instigator Belaphon]] gathered numerous [[drakonid]] and [[dragonspawn]] who felt disvalued and looked down upon by the dragons, leaving Valdrakken to start an active rebellion as the [[Flightless]].[[Reconcilable Dissidents]] The rebels stationed at [[Scalewatch Caverns]] in [[Thaldraszus]] notably ambushed civilians along the roads to Valdrakken until heroes were tasked to halt their operations.[[Rebel Concerns]] When [[Investigator Erima]] discovered they stockpiled explosives beneath the city to collapse the aqueduct from [[Tyrhold]],[[Cause Without a Rebel]] he sent the adventurer to kill [[Agitator Zoralek]] and recover his detonator, saving the capital.[[Irreconcilable Differences]] In order to defend [[Amirdrassil]] from [[Fyrakk]], [[Wrathion]] sent a diplomatic invitation to the [[Netherwing|Netherwing dragonflight]] in [[Outland]] to meet in Valdrakken.[[A Dragon in Hand is Worth Two in the Roost]] The [[nether dragon]]s in return sent [[Mordenaku|Prince Mordenaku]] to serve as their representative. After they negociated that the mountains of [[Thaldraszus]] near the capital would serve as their roost,[[Draconic Diplomacy]] the Netherwing formally joined the Valdrakken Accord.[[A Dragon's Eye View]] ===Exploring Azeroth=== {{Novel-section}} In Year 42 [[ADP]], as [[Thalyssra]] and [[Lor'themar Theron]] traveled across the isles of [[Azeroth]] for a honeymooning spot, they eventually visited Valdrakken with [[Wrathion]] as their guide. The capital was described to be as lively and populous as any [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]] cities, with its own merchants and restaurants, and streets both on the ground and in the air.''[[Exploring Azeroth: Islands and Isles]]'', pg. 174-175 ==Getting there== Valdrakken is located in the west-central area of [[Thaldraszus]]. As the entirety of the Dragon Isles is designed to be traversable by air, it is possible to reach Valdrakken as soon as one has unlocked [[Skyriding]]. It is easily accessible from the [[Waking Shores]] by flying east from the [[Ruby Life Pools]] and can be reached by land with ease from most of Thaldraszus. Various flight paths in all of the zones connect back to Valdrakken as well. It can also be reached through portals in the [[Pathfinder's Den]] in [[Orgrimmar]] and the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] (mage tower) in [[Stormwind City]]. ==Geography== The [[Serene Dreams Spa]] is an offshoot of the city.[[Quilius#Quotes|Quilius' gossip]] ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Valdrakken.jpg|thumb|300px|Map of Valdrakken]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Artisan's Market|The Artisan's Market]] **[[Victorious Visage|The Victorious Visage]] *[[Black Market (Valdrakken)|The Black Market]] *[[Bronze Enclave|The Bronze Enclave]] **[[Parting Glass|The Parting Glass]] *[[Cascade's Edge]] **[[Fallingwater Overlook]] *[[Emerald Enclave|The Emerald Enclave]] *[[Little Scales Daycare]] *[[Obsidian Enclave|The Obsidian Enclave]] **[[Gladiator's Refuge (Valdrakken)|Gladiator's Refuge]] *[[Roasted Ram]] **[[Dragon's Hoard|The Dragon's Hoard]] *[[Ruby Enclave|The Ruby Enclave]] **[[Ruby Feast|The Ruby Feast]] *[[Sapphire Enclave|The Sapphire Enclave]] **[[Azure Archives Annex]] *[[Seat of the Aspects|The Seat of the Aspects]] *[[Valdrakken Treasury Hoard]] *[[Weyrnrest]] |} ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="darktable zebra" |- !
